ST-09.title: Retry/backoff for Yahoo Finance regime-check call sites

sign_off_record.notes: Approved. Both call sites migrated to the established retry_with_backoff pattern (same shape as _yahoo_get_current_price/BLG-BE-71): network call isolated into a decorated raw function that raises on transient failure (retried) or ValueError on unusable data (not retried), outer function preserves the exact prior fallback contract. 7 regression tests (tests/test_regime_retry_backoff.py) confirm retry attempts occur before fallback for both sites and that non-retryable failure modes (HTTP error, no chart data) still fail fast as before. Full pricing/regime/screener_batch test slice (57 tests) passes.

ST-09.notes: Both call sites (pricing.py::check_market_regime/get_ma200 via new _yahoo_fetch_ma200_pair, screener_batch_service.py::_fetch_index_regime via new _fetch_index_regime_raw) refactored to the established retry_with_backoff pattern (same shape as _yahoo_fetch_price/BLG-BE-71). ST-10.title: Idempotent retry for Alpaca paper-trading order sync

sign_off_record.notes: Approved. client_order_id derived deterministically from position_id (f'paper-open-{position_id}'); retry_with_backoff applied via a raise-on-failure raw function, same shape as ST-09. Handles both real-world retry outcomes: a clean retry (identical client_order_id resubmitted, Alpaca's own idempotency prevents a second order) and Alpaca's explicit 422 duplicate-client_order_id rejection (recognised as success, not an error). 6 regression tests confirm no duplicate order across a simulated retry. Best-effort/never-raises contract to the caller preserved; main.py call site updated to pass position_id from add_position()'s return value. 108-test position/paper-trading slice passes.

ST-10.notes: AC scoped sync_open_paper_position only (per backlog item). sync_close_paper_position/get_paper_positions 429-handling gap filed separately as BLG-BE-83 (ST-06 audit).
